summary: Units that service doses are recorded in (U, ml, mg, cc…).
purpose: Each aesthetic service needs a unit: it shows next to each quantity on the aesthetic record, and its step sets how much the + and − buttons change when marking.
tips: A unit in use isn't deleted: it becomes inactive and old sessions keep showing it.

clinic-catalog.measurement-units.btn.del.label: Delete
clinic-catalog.measurement-units.btn.del.description: If it's in use, it becomes inactive instead of being deleted.

clinic-catalog.measurement-units.field.s.label: Symbol
clinic-catalog.measurement-units.field.s.description: What shows next to each quantity.

clinic-catalog.measurement-units.field.c.label: Code
clinic-catalog.measurement-units.field.c.description: Unique identifier: letters, numbers, hyphen and underscore.

clinic-catalog.measurement-units.field.s.label: Quantity step
clinic-catalog.measurement-units.field.s.description: How much + and − change when marking: 1 for whole units, 0.05 for ml.

clinic-catalog.measurement-units.field.i.label: Active
clinic-catalog.measurement-units.field.i.description: Inactive ones aren't offered when setting up services.
